calls.statement:
SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') AS ym, s.store_id<900 AS physical, s.store_id=999 AS training,
 count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids,
 sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category, p.vat_class
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900
)
SELECT strftime(sale_date,'%Y-%m') ym, category='ZZ Test' AS test, vat_rate, vat_class, count(*) n,
 sum(gross_amount) g, sum(net_amount) nt, sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos,
 count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM l GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH l AS (
 SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') ym, sum(f.net_amount) net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT strftime(business_date,'%Y-%m') ym, sum(net_sales_before_returns) ctl, sum(returns_net) ret, min(business_date) mn, max(business_date) mx, count(*) n
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.ym, l.net, r.ctl, l.net-r.ctl AS gap, r.ret, r.mn, r.mx, r.n FROM l JOIN r USING(ym) ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.calendar_year, d.calendar_month, strftime(f.sale_date, '%B %Y') AS month_label,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2
